review: Original PNG visual review via view_image
scope: 20 initial Teams UI fixture originals only; no history, browser, code edits, tests, network, real AD or production Teams validation.

findings.detail: All 8 phone rosters clip right-side columns/actions. English Shared agents header/values are cut and Remove actions are offscreen. zh-TW Role/Joined Hub wraps one character per line; Remove buttons partially clipped. Stills do not verify horizontal scroll or reachability.
All 4 phone drawer screenshots show dimmed page with only about 16px left sidebar sliver; navigation labels/order not visible.
Admin captures start partway into editor; name/top content above capture and bottom buttons clipped. Lead Save below viewport. Vertical scrolling may be intended but unverified.

passes: All 8 desktop images readable, columns aligned, actions distinct, navigation visible in consistent order. Admin has name, department Change, Choose a lead, Delete team; lead omits metadata mutation controls. Visible phone top-level buttons legible with substantial heights.
limitations: Visual only: no interaction, computed geometry, measured contrast, real identity provider or production factory verification.
